deepseek_columns.ai_commands: sshpass -p "$DUT_PASS" ssh -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no $DUT_USER@$DUT_IP "sudo dmidecode -t 17 2>/dev/null | grep -iA1 \"Bank Locator\""

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES; captures bank text without enclosing record, Device Locator pairing or platform naming scope.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED; adds pairing and channel-map validation but lowers capability for pending inputs and overstates global uniqueness.

original_test_intent: Verify that every Type 17 Bank Locator string, interpreted together with its Device Locator and array/socket scope, maps to the approved memory bank/channel topology and remains semantically stable after reboot.
original_method: Capture complete Type 16/17 records, retain raw Bank Locator and paired Device Locator/array handle/population, normalize only under an approved naming rule, compare the scoped bank/channel map and collision policy, then repeat after reboot.
manual_activity: A user approves the platform locator map and reboot plan. Physical inspection is optional corroboration, not the core acceptance action.
required_inputs: Expected Bank Locator and Device Locator pair per slot
Array/socket/channel scope in which names must be unique
Permitted case, punctuation and alias normalization
Policy for empty slots, blank strings and intentionally repeated bank labels
Validated parser and approved reboot/OOB recovery
safety_requirements: Use read-only SMBIOS/inventory; do not move DIMMs or change channel configuration.
Preserve raw strings before normalization and document every normalization rule.
Judge a bank label only with its paired Device Locator, Type 16 array and population state.
Do not require global uniqueness when the approved topology scopes repeated labels by socket/array; do require unambiguous composite identity.
Stop on unresolved mapping/collision or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Build composite array/device/bank identities, validate approved scoped mappings and collisions, and compare semantic pre/post reboot state.
Do not alter memory, invent string aliases or issue PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve bank/channel naming, normalization, scope and locator-pair map.
Approve reboot/recovery, decide whether any collision is intentional and issue the formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The Bank Locator text is relevant, but grep -A1 loses the preceding Type 17 identity and cannot establish Device Locator pairing, array scope or collisions.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive complete raw/decoded Type 16/17 data; report array handle, Type 17 handle, Device Locator, raw/normalized Bank Locator, population and scoped mapping/collision result.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Bank Locator scope, Type 17 script and 5/5-minute values are retained; log clearing and physical memory changes are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.status: COMPOSITE LOCATOR AND SCOPED COLLISION VALIDATION
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Evaluate Bank Locator as one component of a composite Type 17 identity, preserve raw strings, apply approved normalization, map array/socket/channel topology and compare semantics after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: SMBIOS Type 17 memory-device inventories, including multi-socket platforms with repeated local bank names.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC and parser/dmidecode versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 17 Bank Locator/Device Locator string semantics and authoritative platform slot/channel map.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds enclosing record, paired locator, normalization provenance and topology-scoped collision handling.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong channel/socket mapping, ambiguous composites, blank/duplicate labels and raw-string drift without falsely rejecting legitimate cross-socket reuse.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Approved composite locator map and naming/collision policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: OS/EDAC channel labels may use a different namespace and require an explicit mapping rather than text equality.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve bank aliases or repeated local labels, but must define their socket/array scope and composite identity; normalization cannot erase distinctions needed for serviceability.
expected_evidence: Approved platform identity, Bank/Device Locator map, normalization and scope/collision policy
Per-record raw/normalized bank, paired device locator, array/population and composite mapping result
Collision/blank/alias analysis with OS/EDAC mapping only where approved
Approved reboot/health evidence and post-reboot raw plus semantic locator diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Bank Locator is a platform-defined string field; the missing map is an execution input rather than contradictory source semantics.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Composite string/topology validation is fully automatable after the approved mapping.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds complete identity, paired locator, raw-string preservation and scoped topology mapping.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its topology controls, refines uniqueness to approved scope and restores FULLY AUTOMATABLE classification.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates optional physical corroboration and engineer verdict from the automatable metadata core.

review_improvement: Prevents both false acceptance of a bank string detached from its socket and false rejection of legitimate repeated labels on separate arrays.
independent_technical_reasoning: Bank/Device strings and their array links form a finite composite mapping that can be normalized and compared deterministically under an approved topology policy.
